gui.createcityexpansioncore.freight_guid: Set up a point in the world
Place a regular Packager against storage, with its face pointing away from the inventory. Choose Select blocks, then right-click the Packager.
Select a Postbox within 16 blocks of the Packager. Link it to a real station using Create. Build the physical package connection separately.
Check the point mode and the outlined inventory behind the Packager. Creating the point needs explicit confirmation; selecting blocks does not register it.
Right-click to select a block. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand for settings. Choose Build / rotate for normal building.
Build normally. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to return to the guide. Outlines mark selected equipment.
Important: block checks do not prove package transfer. Verify conveyors and train loading with a first real delivery.
Sending: feed storage with belts, funnels or other Create machinery. CCEC requests the assigned item from the selected Packager; each order need not be filled by hand.
Receiving: use a chest, barrel, Create Item Vault or Contract Intake behind the Packager. With insufficient space, the package waits; goods and money are not credited early.

Create warehouse: connect stock-side Packagers with Stock Links. Use a Stock Ticker to request goods to a separate collection address and unpack them into this point's local buffer. CCEC does not yet create network orders automatically.

First test: a small contract → choose source and delivery mode → dispatch → verify receipt. Direct delivery uses an assigned train; for cyclic transport choose regional forwarding and configure Create schedules.
No server response. Open Logistics and start the guide again.
Only a city owner or administrator can set up points.
Freight point created. Assign it as a delivery source or destination in Logistics.
Guide closed. Existing points and deliveries are unchanged.
Guide ended: time expired, permissions changed, or dimension changed. Start again at the Pylon.
Restore a regular Packager; a Repackager is not supported

The warehouse is BEHIND the Packager. The arrow points from the inventory towards the packaging face.
Build a physical package connection from the Packager to the Postbox. Nearby blocks are not automatically connected.
Link the Postbox to a real train station using Create. The train needs attached cargo inventory and must stop here for mail transfer.
At the destination, CCEC validates sealed packages and moves goods into a chest, barrel, Create Item Vault or Contract Intake.
First deliver a small real order. Setup checks blocks and addresses; only real cargo proves the conveyor and train handoff work. No test goods or CR are created.
For a distributed warehouse, connect stock-side Packagers through Stock Links to the same Create network.
The Stock Ticker requests goods from that network. Network signals carry requests, not items: packages still need a physical path.
Collect and unpack warehouse requests into a local dispatch buffer behind the CCEC Packager. Use a separate local collection address.
Current CCEC dispatch draws from its local Packager. Create handles warehouse replenishment; CCEC does not yet generate Stock Ticker network orders or automatic return trips.
